round2_findings_resolved.why: «کس جگہ» is the oblique interrogative ('at which place'), so the label now asks the reader to choose a destination instead of naming the current place; the <Select> it labels offers «Public hub» (ui.hub.pages.scope.public) and organization names, which is what the label introduces. Grammar: کس agrees with the feminine singular جگہ; the respectful imperative شائع کریں matches the ur guide's command form. It also matches the received hi pattern 'कहाँ प्रकाशित करें' and the fr 'Publier vers' / ru 'Куда опубликовать' family.

round2_findings_resolved.why: pull now stays Latin throughout the surface, as the glossary's wave-2 kept-English set requires for git/hub operations ('Inflect around them; never translate inside them'), and as shipped ur already renders the same operation (ui.hub.subscriptions.pull 'اب pull کریں', subscribe_description 'دستی pull دستیاب رہتا ہے'). The Urdu grammar around the kept token is correct in each frame: imperative pull کریں; in-flight masculine pull ہو رہا ہے; object-marked ٹیم {name} کو pull کریں and کسی ٹیم کو pull کرنے پر/کے لیے; passive-ability کو pull نہیں کیا جا سکا; feminine agreement on the team as subject (ٹیم … pull نہیں ہو سکی) in the publication headline twin. The label is lower-case 'pull', which is also what makes label-in-name hold: the visible label 'pull کریں' is a substring of the accessible name 'ٹیم {name} کو pull کریں'; my round-2 suggested capitalisation would have broken that match, so the choice here is better than what I proposed.
